scenarios.name: RevRunaway-01 revision_system.j2 instructs modified_responsibilities contains only changes

steps.text: the template revision_system.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "modified_responsibilities list must contain ONLY responsibilities you are CHANGING"
the template text contains "Do NOT restate the entire control structure"
the template text contains "only new and modified elements"

scenarios.name: RevRunaway-02 revision_user.j2 does not include use_case_text

steps.text: the template revision_user.j2 is loaded
the template text does not contain "use_case_text"
the template text does not contain "{{ use_case_text }}"

scenarios.name: RevRunaway-03 revision_system.j2 contains control structure listing, not revision_user.j2

steps.text: the template revision_system.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "Existing Control Structure"
the template text contains "Responsibilities"
the template revision_user.j2 is loaded
the template text does not contain "Current Control Structure"
the template text contains "Critic Findings"

scenarios.name: RevRunaway-04 safe_llm_call accepts a max_completion_tokens parameter

steps.text: the safe_llm_call function signature is inspected
the function accepts a max_completion_tokens parameter with default None

scenarios.name: RevRunaway-05 safe_llm_call passes max_completion_tokens to complete

steps.text: an LLM client with a mocked complete method
safe_llm_call is called with max_completion_tokens 4096
the complete method is called with max_completion_tokens 4096

scenarios.name: RevRunaway-06 safe_llm_call without max_completion_tokens does not override client default

steps.text: an LLM client with a mocked complete method
safe_llm_call is called without max_completion_tokens
the complete method is called with max_completion_tokens None
an LLM that returns a valid RevisionDelta
the revision is run
the LLM complete call is made with max_completion_tokens 8192

scenarios.name: RevRunaway-08 new_responsibilities with existing resp_id is rejected

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with new_responsibilities containing RESP-1
the revision is run
the final control structure does not contain a duplicate RESP-1
a warning is logged about the rejected duplicate resp_id RESP-1

scenarios.name: RevRunaway-09 new_responsibilities with genuinely new resp_id is accepted

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with new_responsibilities containing RESP-3 with valid PM, CA, and FB elements
the revision is run
the final control structure contains RESP-3

scenarios.name: RevRunaway-10 duplicate rejection does not affect modified_responsibilities replacement

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with modified_responsibilities containing RESP-1 with an updated description
the RevisionDelta also has new_responsibilities containing RESP-2
the revision is run
the final control structure contains RESP-1 with the updated description
a warning is logged about the rejected duplicate resp_id RESP-2
the final control structure does not contain a duplicate RESP-2

scenarios.name: RevRunaway-11 revision_system.j2 preserves existing delta and ID rules

steps.text: the template revision_system.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "Do NOT restate the entire control structure"
the template text contains "ID format rules"
the template text contains "solution-neutrality"

scenarios.name: RevRunaway-12 revision_system.j2 renders successfully with the new instruction

steps.text: the template revision_system.j2 is loaded
the template is rendered with control_structure and next_ids
the rendered text contains "modified_responsibilities list must contain ONLY"
the rendered text does not contain "{{"

background.text: the STPA system model revision module is importable
the STPA system model llm_helpers module is importable
a control structure with responsibilities RESP-1 and RESP-2 is available
CriticFindings with unjustified gaps are available
a run directory for call logging
